reviews.concise_rationale: The crop is coherent and readable: it shows a source cell sequence flowing through an encoder, gene embeddings, an adapter, and prompt/instruction embeddings into the decoder. That is enough to support the full fine-tuning route.

The crop clearly shows the multimodal cell-context alignment path with both cell-type and gene-profile encoders feeding H_ctx, plus the promoter input on the same diagram. It is readable and supports both listed conditioning routes.
The selected crop shows a readable scRNA-seq to BioEncoder to projected [BIO] soft-token prompt path with arrows intact. That is a coherent preview for the scRNA-seq soft-token route.

The crop is readable and forms a complete source-to-model input path from cell sequence through encoder and adapter into the LLM prompt/decoder stack. It is a usable scientific preview for the LoRA variant route.
